sahneler.metin: A B-52 carrying two nuclear bombs broke apart over North Carolina.
Suddenly both bombs fell toward the ground.
A tanker crew had spotted a fuel leak in its wing.
Some safety devices on one bomb activated during the fall.
Engineers later judged it one switch away from detonation.
It pushed improvements in weapon safety design.

aciklama:
